supple_description.title: Chic Urban Apartment with Modern Amenities
supple_description.text: Experience stylish living in this vibrant Queens apartment featuring a spacious bedroom and contemporary bathroom. The open-concept layout boasts a gourmet island kitchen with granite countertops and sleek appliances. Enjoy year-round comfort with central air conditioning and the convenience of an elevator. Additional storage space is available in the full basement. Perfectly blending modern design and convenience, this residence is ideal for urban living.

supple_description.title: 1-bed Briarwood apartment with 24hr doorman
supple_description.text: 1-bed apartment in Briarwood, this bright unit features an open layout with separate dining area, hardwood floors, and ample closet space. The 800 sqft layout sits in a full-service doorman building with hotel-like lobby, on-site laundry, storage, and bike room. Steps to E/F express trains and city buses for easy commuting throughout Queens and Manhattan.

supple_description.title: Luxury Ridgewood Apartment with Rooftop Views
supple_description.text: Experience luxury living in Ridgewood with this beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment featuring stainless steel appliances, high ceilings, and hardwood floors. Enjoy abundant natural light, a state-of-the-art gym, and access to stunning rooftop views. The building offers convenient on-site laundry and inviting outdoor areas for relaxation. Pet-friendly, this residence combines comfort and style in a vibrant community.

supple_description.title: Spacious 2-Bedroom Apartment with Modern Touches
supple_description.text: This charming 2-bedroom railroad-style apartment offers a fresh, functional layout with modern finishes, including a new refrigerator and stove. Featuring a generous walk-in closet, heat and hot water included, and located just off Myrtle Avenue, enjoy convenience with shops and dining nearby. Commuting to Manhattan is a breeze with various bus options close by. Perfect for anyone seeking comfort and ease in Glendale!

supple_description.title: 1-bed Forest Hills apartment with doorman
supple_description.text: A 1-bed apartment in New York, NY's Forest Hills neighborhood, this 800 sqft unit features hardwood floors, an updated kitchen and bathroom, and central air. All utilities are included in the monthly rent, with 24-hour doorman service in the luxury coop building. Close to shopping and transportation with ample closet space throughout.

supple_description.title: 1-bed Woodside apartment near top schools
supple_description.text: Apartment in Woodside, this bright 1-bed, 1-bath unit in Boulevard Gardens offers 600 sqft with hardwood floors, updated kitchen with stainless appliances, and peaceful garden courtyards. The pre-war building features on-site laundry and professional management. Minutes from R/M and 7 trains for 15-20 minute commutes to Midtown, with top-rated schools within 0.3 miles.

supple_description.title: Renovated 1-bed Auburndale co-op near LIRR
supple_description.text: A apartment in Auburndale, this renovated 1-bed, 1-bath co-op sits minutes from Auburndale and Bayside LIRR stations for quick Manhattan commutes. The unit features an updated kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances, hardwood floors, high ceilings, and a marble bath. Located on a quiet tree-lined block with easy access to Northern Boulevard shops and major highways.

supple_description.title: New 1-bed Kew Gardens condo near LIRR & JFK
supple_description.text: This 1-bed, 1-bath condo in Kew Gardens sits half a block from LIRR, E Train, and AirTrain JFK connections. The 600 sqft unit features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, radiant heat flooring, and in-unit laundry. Building amenities include a fitness center, rooftop deck with skyline views, controlled access, garage parking, and a pet spa.

supple_description.title: 1-bed Astoria apartment with utilities included
supple_description.text: This utilities-included 1-bed, 1-bath apartment in Astoria features a newly renovated 750 sqft layout with all utilities and internet covered in rent. A fit for remote workers with high-speed internet and nearby coworking spaces, plus a fenced yard for outdoor space. Close to transportation, cafes, and a top-rated elementary school just 0.2 miles away.

supple_description.title: 1-bed apartment near St. John's & Queens College
supple_description.text: Sitting in Kew Gardens Hills, this 1-bed, 1-bath apartment features a south-facing layout with a large attic for extra storage and a separate thermostat for climate control. Located near Parsons Blvd and Union Turnpike, it's walking distance to St. John's University, Queens College, and Queens Hospital Center with top-rated schools within blocks.

review.text:
Just renewed my lease. I greatly appreciate being able to live on my  own and commute to NYC. The concept is interesting and convenient. Perfect for one person who doesn’t need a lot of stuff. Ninja foodie is my oven, but it was pretty much the same story before moving in. I don’t feel like I’m living without. I even have a little dishwasher that fits on the counter and has its own water tank so it doesn’t have to attach to anything. It fits one of the cabinets for storage. Rent is all-inclusive, so you know exactly what to expect each month. Laundry is through an app that gives an option to play games for credits. You can see the Statue of Liberty from the roof, which is always a nice view. Flip Sigi keeps me in the loop with their new dishes and is generous with $5 coupons if you sign up for texts. If you want something healthier Rositah’s Yah down the block is very good.
I’ve only had to call maintenance for one minor thing and the issue was fixed within about a day. I haven’t used the community room, but the gym has all you need for standard workouts. I’m a treadmill and weights person, myself. I’ve seen the building and property managers be more responsive and helpful than a lot of other places. They took over the building from Common Co-living, which has been a relief.

I do understand both sides of the summer rooftop party debate, it’s been every other weekend which does start to feel excessive. I also don’t know what the security situation is. I am pretty sensitive to noise, but haven’t heard the music be too loud and appreciate that they are respectful in turning it off at 10pm. I also have noise cancelling ear muffs if I ever need zero sound, something I purchased long before moving here, so the situation hasn’t bothered me much.

review.text: So grateful we found and chose Parkside to live in for two years while I’m here for grad school. The building is quiet, the amenities are nice, the maintenance staff and the office staff are the best, and we love the view of Amistad Park. This is also a quiet part of downtown which is super nice at night - I know others who live in busier downtown areas and have trouble sleeping b/c of the motorcycles, people coming out of bars, etc. The gym is great and so are the offices/study rooms in the lobby. review.text:
I'm not sure I have the words to quantify how pleased I am with this community. My transition here was the most seamless I've ever experienced, & I've moved around quite a bit. As such, I have had a million questions and Emily and Paul are so kind and accommodating that they've made and continue to make everything so easy. The entire complex is just so aesthetically pleasing, but my apartment is to die for. It's spacious and bright with super high ceilings and huge windows, but most importantly I don't hear my neighbors, like at all. The hallways and common spaces are always spotless, even the trash room seems to emptied multiple times per day. The few maintenance requests I've had to put in have been resolved same day by Jose and Zilroy, both with a smile. Having a pretty apartment is all good, but a team of staff who actually want to be here and want to help is invaluable. I can't say enough good things about them.

I think it's important to note that this is still New Haven, and safety will always be an issue. That said, I've never felt unsafe here. There's a patrol car here at night and the huge parking lot is always super well lit. The communication about the happenings of the community has also always been top notch. Cheers to never having to worry about missing packages! :)

I literally never want to leave.
review.name: Patricia Morency
